title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-28
source: Lineage:MR@ 7.5 ips>R @ 7.5 ips.(Wilson Boswell). Truckin thru Bird Song is from a second gen reel. Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre pair Tesla tubes circa 1980  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC; Transfered and mastered by Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: High‑fidelity soundboard capture of a solid ’71 Fillmore show featuring a smoking Other One, strong Dark Star and standout Pigpen numbers.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an excellent soundboard source with spacious, open acoustics though a little hard‑edged compared to later years. Musically the show is regarded as fairly good – the Other One (the “Skullfuck” version) and Dark Star shine, while the attempted That's It suite falls short of the band’s peak that night.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are largely favorable (5★ and 4★); show quality is solid with standout tracks, recording is described as excellent to good, yielding a combined rating around 4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Spacious and open sound with crisp clarity; some reviewers note a hard‑edged, brittle character lacking the warmth of later years but no major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fairly good overall; the band attempted the full That's It suite but Cryptical 1 was omitted, making the show a notch below the two nights prior.
